ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) central pixels to low-intensity (black) peripheral and mottled pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs occupy the interior regions of both lobes; continuous black pigmentation bands the trailing edges; dense black mottling is localized on the leading edges and the inner quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 35 degrees; the vertex is partially obscured by water displacement.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entirety of both trailing edges; the right lobe exhibits deeper, more jagged pixel-amplitude variations compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges transitioning into slightly rounded, heavily textured distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring are visible on the far left tip and along the outer margin of the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three parallel dark linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the left lobe; a single diagonal white scratch is present on the central-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily irregular and eroded trailing edge on the far left tip; distinct 'Y' shaped scar located on the lower-mid region of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in mottling density between the two lobes, with the right lobe showing significantly more dark pixel encroachment from the leading edge toward the center.
